name: biology-research-superpowers
description: Evidence-grounded biological research workflow from hypothesis and literature to genomics, phylogeny, simulation, functional assays, reproducible analysis, manuscripts and FAIR deposition.

author.name: Community biology adaptation; based on research-superpowers by Patrick Leiverkus

interface.longDescription: Design, search, analyze, validate and publish biological research with verifiable provenance and explicit scientific gates.
defaultPrompt: Build an auditable microbial comparative genomics and rhodopsin evolution research plan.
Review my protein evolution simulator scientific qualification and HPC evidence.
Audit evidence for a manuscript and distinguish computational predictions from wet-lab function.
